summary: Implemented the 3-phase plan: roadmap-integration.sh's write_or_diff now emits a named, change-aware OUTCOME: stderr line on both --regenerate and --prune (4 shapes: rewrote / left unchanged / dry-run would-change / dry-run no-change), with 12 new regression cases (105/105 passing). roadmap-format.md and roadmap-update.md corrected to document the line and the settled classic/stage layout ruling. Redeployed the core extension; all four touched files confirmed byte-identical source-store vs. deployed, and the live --regenerate --dry-run invocation against specs/ROADMAP.md confirmed correct with the file unchanged. Phase 3's full gate set was discharged via the dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral directive (scoped run-all.sh --only and verify-deploy.sh --only-gate invocations, plus two individually-named unmappable checks run directly) rather than an independent full sweep.
